_comment: Regression baseline for the runtime-agent pipeline benchmarks. allocs_per_op and b_per_op are HARDWARE-INDEPENDENT (a function of the code path, identical on any CPU/OS) and are the authoritative CI regression signal wired in increment 2 — a jump here is real allocation rot. ns_per_op_local is HARDWARE-DEPENDENT reference only (captured on the env below); the CI gate compares ns/op against a runner-generated figure with a loose (~2x) ceiling that trips only on gross regressions, never on VM noise. Regenerate with bench/regen.sh.

BenchmarkEvaluate_BalancedSidecar.note: includes one localhost HTTP hop (httptest client+server); allocs vary with net/http, reported not gated

BenchmarkEvaluate_ComprehensiveSidecar.note: two localhost HTTP hops (Stage-2 uncertain + Stage-3 judge); reported not gated
